<json>
{
  "lemmas": [
    {
      "lemma": "property lemma_1; @(posedge clk) disable iff (rst) (i <= N); endproperty",
      "explanation": "The index starts at zero, increments only while below N, and then stops. This bound rules out an overshot index when the FSM enters DONE."
    },
    {
      "lemma": "property lemma_2; @(posedge clk) disable iff (rst) (sum == i / 3); endproperty",
      "explanation": "Each increment of i to a multiple of three increments sum exactly once. This gives the counter-to-index relationship needed at completion."
    },
    {
      "lemma": "property lemma_3; @(posedge clk) disable iff (rst) ((state != DONE) || (i == N)); endproperty",
      "explanation": "The FSM enters DONE only after i reaches N; lemma_1 excludes a larger value. In DONE, lemma_2 therefore gives sum = N / 3 = n."
    }
  ]
}
</json>

These lemmas apply to the default parameters and configurations where `N` fits in `i` without wraparound. If `N` exceeds the index’s range, `lemma_2` is not invariant.

      "lemma": "property lemma_3; @(posedge clk) disable iff (rst) (state == DONE) |-> (i == N); endproperty",
      "explanation": "The FSM enters DONE only after i reaches N. Together with lemma_2 and N = 3*n, this gives sum = n."

These lemmas assume reset has initialized the state and `3*n` fits in `WIDTH` bits, as it does for the default parameters.
